title: too light
text: too light. I've never had a clock like this before so I have nothing to compare it to. My old clock died and it would set the time automatically when plugged in and this does not. Slightly annoying but not a huge deal.  I'm pretty sure I read in the description that you can and the projection any way, which is false so I'm stuck with it upside down on my ceiling.  To get the projection right the actual clock is facing the wall, which is useless. My biggest problem with the clock is how light it is. There isn't enough weight for it to stay on my night stand. I leave a USB cord plugged in so I can hook up my phone when I go to bed. Unfortunately, every time I touch the USB cord the entire clock literally falls off the night stand. It's very frustrating. I would gladly pay more money for a quality product and wish I didn't buy this clock...
